name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, findings, and filters them by severity
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Exercises the refactored ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md). Then exercises the severity counter pills (spec client/specs/run-severity-filter.md): the seeded run has 1 CRITICAL + 1 SUGGESTION (the out-of-scope N+1 finding, downgraded from WARNING by L03), clicking CRITICAL leaves exactly one finding card, clicking it again restores both. The findings list is a named ARIA list ("N findings shown"), so the assertion is the rendered cards, not the pill label.
